Please act as an independent, skeptical scientific convergence reviewer for a
bounded multi-agent credit-assignment investment question. Do not assume any
prior consultant's view, and do not assume that continued work, narrowing, or
parking is preferred. The question is whether any of three smallest
multi-waiter, multi-step finite host families supplies association-specific
decision value that a competent same-information generic conditional-value
estimator cannot reproduce, before any relay or sampled training is attempted.

Treat the code only as scientific reference for B1's host, estimands,

The newer T3 evidence and the present analytic constructions are local and are
not represented as reachable at that public commit. Treat the following as a
complete bounded evidence statement about them. T3 used exactly three agents
and passed balanced ordered-waiter support: every directed natural and
interaction contrast was 0.8, identity main effects were zero, and severing
the waiter transition collapsed every contrast to zero. But competent
same-information pair-aware GAE and pair-Q had gradient cosine
1.0000000000000002, maximum noiseless favorable-probability difference zero,
and Bellman residual 5.551115123125783e-17. The oracle's sampled favorable-
allocation probability shift was positive but only 2.2238206119185033e-05;
actual fixed-token allocation and normalized-utility gaps were exactly zero
with intervals [0,0], and source-localized excess was about 0.000543 with an
interval spanning zero. T3 is protected terminal evidence and is not being
rerun or repaired.

The new search prospectively fixed exactly three family slots in this order:
overlapping many-to-one contention, serial two-hop complementarity, and a
censored substitution chain. Each receives only one smallest balanced
construction, with exactly three persistent agents and all six ordered
source-waiter assignments equally represented. The source action is binary at
behavior probability one half, content sign is balanced, identity never pays
reward, and the two eligible waiters have the same generic action-time
features. A public edge key records the current relation and is given to every
arm. External utility is bounded in [0,1].

Ordinary GAE, a competent pair-aware conditional-Q or Rao-Blackwellized arm,
and the association candidate share action-time information, trajectories,
event and edge keys, downstream observations, decomposition objects, policy
and model capacity, useful work, preconditioner, trust map, update count, and
scarce evaluator. If the association construction consumes a transformation,
routing rule, event object, or sufficient statistic, the generic arm receives
the same object and may condition or Rao-Blackwellize it within the same work
budget. No arm may use identity as reward, a privileged counterfactual, hidden
work, or an intentionally weaker critic.

The registered gates are demanding by design. After the common preconditioner,
the association update needs normalized orthogonal residual at least 0.10 and
must change an actual scarce decision. Against both GAE and the generic arm it
needs favorable-allocation and normalized-utility gains of at least 0.10 with
positive exact balanced-panel lower bounds. Native-minus-severed association-
versus-generic utility excess must be at least 0.05 with a positive lower
bound. Generic-target equality or a failed margin stops the family before
relay and sampled training.

Here are the three exact finite surfaces to review independently.

In overlapping contention, activating the tested source writes a pending job
into its true waiter's physical state. That job and a pre-existing background
record compete for one later queue slot, and the admitted record attempts
service. For positive content, utility changes from 0 under deferral to 1
under activation; for negative content it changes from 1 to 0. The pathwise
association contrast and the exact external conditional-Q contrast are both
the content sign. With minimal source features (1, sign), both candidate and
generic population updates are (0, 1/4).

In serial complementarity, activation marks the true waiter; the waiter's
later open-or-block action then permits or prevents a third agent's downstream
commit. Utility is paid only after this ordered two-hop path. The same balanced
0-to-1 and 1-to-0 utility table applies, so the pathwise contrast and exact
conditional-Q contrast are again the content sign and both source updates are
(0, 1/4). Later shared action-record contributions are identical across arms.

In censored substitution, the original waiter persists, the record expires,
or the third agent substitutes as holder, with all three modes equally likely
and unknown at source-action time. Activation has content-sign effect under
persistence or replacement and zero effect under expiry. The realized
pathwise target is therefore heterogeneous, but its action-time conditional
mean is two-thirds times the content sign; candidate and generic updates are
both (0, 1/6). Conditional averaging removes lifetime-mode variance.

The analytic equality claim is record-wise. If S is an action record's policy
score and C is the scalar actually used by the association update after every
admitted binding, transformation, normalization, or routing operation, define
Cbar as the conditional expectation of C given the permitted action history,
action, and shared conditioning objects. Because S is measurable at the
action record, the tower property gives E[sum S C] = E[sum S Cbar]. Identical
population updates remain identical after a common preconditioner and trust
map, so they make the same scarce decisions. On that reading all three
constructions have orthogonal residual zero, allocation and utility advantage
zero, and native-minus-severed excess zero, despite their large real physical
path effects.

Please scrutinize rather than assume that argument. The strongest objection is
that letting the generic arm condition or Rao-Blackwellize the candidate's
transformed target may absorb the treatment by definition. A deliberately
biased relation-indexed surrogate can be noncollinear with the true external-
return gradient at a finite trust radius and can sometimes improve a
nonconcave coordination objective. Decide whether the prospective parity
contract legitimately gives that transformed object to a generic estimator,
making any gain generic target or optimizer geometry, or whether doing so
silently turns the generic arm into the association method. If you believe a
biased finite-step route survives, specify the smallest admissible
construction and show why the same-object generic arm cannot reproduce it,
why it is not task-specific shaping, and how it could meet every 0.10 and 0.05
gate without tuning after observation.

Also assess whether exact finite enumeration makes the comparison vacuous,
whether a larger member of one family is scientifically required despite the
predeclared smallest-construction law, and whether finite-data or capacity-
limited learned critics define a credible but materially different reentry.
A future approximation-efficiency comparison would have to freeze both critic
classes, parameters, data, optimizer state, FLOPs, memory, event-key access,
and native allocation and utility endpoints; it cannot weaken the present
generic arm merely to manufacture a gap.

Please return a conclusion-first scientific review that classifies each family
as a full survivor, a generic-denoising or optimizer effect, a support-only
null, or an invalid comparison. State whether any executable exact observation
is still decision-changing or whether a static no-CM stop is justified.
Disposition every material objection, including comparator overreach, biased
finite-step coordination, canonical-minimality, exact-estimator strength,
shared-parameter effects, censoring, and source localization. Identify the
strongest evidence against your own conclusion and the common failure risk for
finite-host credit research.

Finally, give an independent bounded investment recommendation among
continued work at this exact scope, narrowing to a distinct generic
denoising/representation question, parking pending genuinely new evidence,
closing, fusing, or spinning off. Name the smallest scientifically distinct
reentry discriminator. Do not recommend rerunning or extending T3, weakening
a comparator, adding a relay arm, changing the frozen margins, or tuning a
family after seeing its comparison.

Keep the maximum claim confined to these three smallest balanced,
fixed-population, finite-horizon, exact-population, single-update abstract
